caption: The drawing depicts a large bird, likely an eagle, occupying the center of the composition with its wings extended horizontally. The eagle is outlined and detailed in shades of gray and black. At its chest, there is a shield with seven vertical red and white stripes. The eagle grips a bundle of arrows tied together in its left claw and a leafy green branch with red berries in its right claw. Above the eagle's head, a green and gold ribbon displays the text "WESTON BROCKWAY" in uppercase letters. Encircling the eagle's head, there are thirteen yellow five-pointed stars connected by a black vine. The background is a pale gray color. Green leaves and red-pink flowers and berries are arranged symmetrically in the corners and sides of the image, framing the eagle. The lines and colors are flat and clearly separated, and the overall style is simple and decorative.
title: Wall Painting
